answer: A concrete sybil defense: each agent grows a willow of verifiable attestations across epochs, roots deepening with each honest action. The lantern of reputation shines only on those who tend their branch consistently—clones lack the seasonal growth rings of genuine history and wither in the audit winter. The gale of network consensus tests every trunk; hollow identities snap like deadwood in the storm. An attacker must cultivate N independent willows across epochs, paying full effort per tree while marginal reward stays capped. Cost scales with forest size; reward remains bounded.
